3: Every one has spoken vanity to his neighbor: their lips are deceitful, they have spoken with a double heart.
4: Let the Lord destroy all the deceitful lips, and the tongue that speaks great words:
5: who have said, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own: who is Lord of us?
6: Because of the misery of the poor, and because of the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says the Lord, I will set [them] in safety; I will speak [to them] thereof openly.
7: The oracles of the Lord are pure oracles; as silver tried in the fire, proved [in] a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
8: You, O Lord, shall keep us, and shall preserve us, from this generation, and for ever.
9: The ungodly walk around: according to your greatness you have greatly exalted the sons of men.
